chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) who said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, who said: Al-Ma'la ibn Muhammad al-Basri narrated from Muhammad ibn Jumhur al-Ummi, from Ja'far ibn Bashir al-Bajali, from Abu Bahrs, from Sharih al-Hamdani, from Abu Ishaq al-Sabi'i, from Al-Harith al-A'war, who said: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said:
A Muslim is perfected by three characteristics: deep understanding of the religion, moderation in livelihood, and patience during calamities.

key_terms.التَّفَقُّهُ: Deep understanding or proficiency in religious matters
key_terms.التَّقْدِيرُ: Moderation or balance in one's affairs

ai.seo_question: What are the three characteristics that perfect a Muslim according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) outlines the triad of spiritual, material, and emotional maturity required for a complete Muslim. The emphasis on *al-tafquh* (deep understanding) reflects the Shia priority on jurisprudential and theological depth, while *al-taqdir* (moderation/balance) in sustenance aligns with the concept of *wasatiyyah* (centrism) in daily life. This teaching underscores that true perfection is not merely ritualistic but involves a balanced integration of knowledge, economic prudence, and resilience (*sabr*) against life's trials.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 3-120 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Aba Abdullah, on the authority of Al-Mo’ali ibn Muhammad al-Basry, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Jumhoor al-Ummi,on the authority of Ja’far ibn Bashiral-Bajaly, on the authority of Abi Bahr, on the authority of Sharih al-Hamedany, on the authority of Abi Ishaq al-Sabi’e, on the authority of Al-Harith al-A’oar that the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali (MGB) said, “
A Muslim is perfected by three characteristics: knowledge of the affairs of the religion; moderation in the affairs of life; and patience during calamities.”
